events.text: Ships from beyond the sea anchor in the harbour: sailors with red beards, strange spices and stranger swords.

effects.log: A brass compass for a jar of tea. It points north stubbornly. You like it.
Thin blades, straight lines, no footwork at all. You learn something anyway.

events.text: Pirates raid the fishing village at dawn. The village has three old spears and a lot of angry grandmothers.

ok.log: The pirates sail away with nothing but bruises. The grandmothers feed you for a month.

fail.log: They take the fish and leave you in the surf.

choices.text: Hide the children in the caves

effects.log: Not one child is found. The pirates leave confused.

events.text: A typhoon hits the coast. Roofs fly, boats sink, and the sea comes up to the temple steps.

effects.log: Soaked, bruised and exhausted. Half the boats survive because of you.
You spend the night holding the door against the wind with twelve strangers. You are all friends by morning.

events.text: The pearl divers of the coast hold their breath for as long as it takes to boil an egg. They laugh at martial artists who think they have strong lungs.

ok.log: You come up with a pearl and their grudging respect. (30 taels)

fail.log: You come up choking, pearl-less and laughed at.

effects.log: Their breathing is a qi method nobody wrote down. You write it down.

events.text: An old woman keeps the lighthouse on the point, as her mother did. Her lamp oil is running out.

effects.log: Ten taels of oil. Three ships come home safely that month.

choices.text: Keep the light for a night

effects.log: You watch the dark sea all night. You feel very small, and useful.

events.text: The morning fish market: shouting, silver scales, and a crab that has escaped and is heading for the sea with great determination.

effects.log: The fishmonger chases you both. The crab makes it.
Grilled on the beach. Best meal of the year.

events.text: A foreign monk with blue eyes preaches in the harbour square. He speaks the language badly and kindly.

effects.log: His god is strange, but his questions are good ones. You think about them for weeks.
He blesses you in three languages. One of them might be yours.

events.text: The salt pans shimmer in the sun. Workers rake white crystals in the heat, their skin cracked by salt.

choices.text: Work a season on the pans

effects.log: Hard, hot, honest. (18 taels)
A bucket of fresh water is worth more than silver out here.

events.text: A merchant ship runs aground on the reef. Survivors cling to the rocks as the tide rises.

ok.log: One rope, twelve survivors. The merchant gives you a chest of spices.

fail.log: The sea throws you back twice. The third time you make it, half-drowned.

choices.text: Light fires to guide the boats

effects.log: The fishermen bring them all in by torchlight.

events.text: In the harbour taverns, people whisper that the Hushed Lantern Pavilion keeps its headquarters on an island no map shows.

effects.log: He goes pale and leaves his fish. You pay for them.
Some islands are better unfound.

events.text: The fishing villages hold their festival for the Sea Goddess: boats covered in flowers and a procession into the waves.

effects.log: Up to your chest in the sea, singing. The goddess must be pleased; the catch is good all year.
A thousand lanterns floating on the evening tide.

events.text: At low tide, a cave appears under the cliffs. Crates inside are marked with the seal of the Water Gang.

effects.log: The magistrate thanks you, and quietly takes a cut. The Water Gang does not find out who told.
You walk away. Behind you, the tide comes back in, and the cave vanishes.

events.text: Swimming off the rocks, you see a grey fin circling between you and the shore.

ok.log: You reach the rocks first. The shark looks disappointed.

fail.log: Its teeth graze your leg. You reach the rocks bleeding and very awake.

effects.log: The shark loses interest. You swim in very, very slowly.

events.text: A foreign sailor in the tavern challenges anyone to a fistfight, 'for sport'. He is enormous and very cheerful.

ok.log: You win. He laughs, buys you a bowl of fish soup and teaches you a sailor's knot.

fail.log: He wins. He laughs, buys you a bowl of fish soup and teaches you a sailor's knot.

effects.log: You learn about lands where the sun sets in the sea. You do not believe half of it.

events.text: An old coastal master trains his students by making them stand in the surf while the waves knock them down.

effects.log: You fall two hundred times. On the two hundred and first wave, you do not.
He looks at you and says "Coward" with great affection.
